article:
Test 17
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Toby Harris, actor
17-year-old Toby Harris has already appeared in a number of films.
Acting is something that I’ve been interested in for ages. My aunt belonged to a drama group, and I used to watch her shows when I was a child. But it was only when I was 11 that I joined a theatre club and started acting regularly. I had accompanied a school friend, who was nervous about going alone, and I signed up that same evening! My drama teacher was happy because she’d always said I was talented.
A while later, a film director saw me in one of the club’s plays and asked me to be in her film. I said yes, and for me, that was the start of everything. I thought the film would be scary to do, as I was the youngest person at the film studio. I was really calm during the whole thing though, which I hadn’t expected. Everyone was so friendly! I didn’t have that much to do, not like the main star. He’s become very well-known since we worked together. All his films are extremely successful.
I’ve done a few films now. The last was a comedy, which I was glad to finish – it’s not something I find easy! I often get asked for tips about getting into films. Everyone thinks that who you know is important. Maybe that used to be true. Nowadays, it’s about experience. There are lots of directors looking for new actors for different film projects, so accept as much work as you can! Even two minutes on camera is useful. Also, ignore reviews. Positive comments are lovely to get, but people can also be unkind!
Recently, I finished a big film, and now I’m planning for the future. I tried for a part in a television series; they chose someone else in the end unfortunately – I’m fine with it, though. It’s part of being an actor! I’m taking advantage of a break to do some horse riding. I was taught how to do it on an advanced acting course last year and I need to make sure I still remember everything – it’s good for my CV, to show I’d be good in action films, for example!

questions.text: Toby decided to join a theatre club after

options.label: A
options.text: his teacher recommended it to him.

options.label: B
options.text: his aunt was involved in running it.

options.label: C
options.text: he saw other children acting in one of its plays.

options.label: D
options.text: he enjoyed a session he’d gone to with a friend.

questions.explanation: 解析：Toby 决定加入戏剧俱乐部是因为 “accompanied a school friend... and I signed up that same evening”（陪朋友参加后自己也报名），对应 D 选项 “享受和朋友一起参加的活动”。A 选项 “老师推荐”、B 选项 “阿姨参与运营”、C 选项 “看到其他孩子表演” 与原文 “陪朋友去，当晚报名” 不符。

questions.text: How did Toby feel about the first film he acted in?

options.label: A
options.text: excited about working with the famous people in it

options.label: B
options.text: surprised at how relaxed he felt when making it

options.label: C
options.text: pleased to have such a big part in it

options.label: D
options.text: amazed at how popular it was

questions.explanation: 解析：Toby 拍第一部电影时，“was really calm during the whole thing though, which I hadn’t expected”（惊讶于自己的放松），对应 B 选项 “惊讶于拍摄时的放松”。A 选项 “兴奋与名人合作”、C 选项 “高兴有大角色”、D 选项 “惊讶于电影受欢迎” 与原文 “戏份不多，未听说过颁奖者” 不符。

questions.text: Toby advises young people interested in being in films to

options.label: A
options.text: ask for people’s opinions about their performance.

options.label: B
options.text: watch a range of films by different directors.

options.label: C
options.text: get to know other people in the industry.

options.label: D
options.text: take any roles that are offered.

questions.explanation: 解析：Toby 建议想拍电影的年轻人 “accept as much work as you can! Even two minutes on camera is useful”（接受任何提供的角色），对应 D 选项 “接受任何提供的角色”。A 选项 “询问他人对表演的意见”、B 选项 “观看不同导演的电影”、C 选项 “结识行业内其他人” 与原文 “如今更重经验，接受任何工作” 不符。

questions.text: What is Toby going to do next?

options.label: A
options.text: practise a useful skill

options.label: B
options.text: star in a TV programme

options.label: C
options.text: play a part in an exciting film

options.label: D
options.text: teach on a course for advanced actors

questions.explanation: 解析：Toby 接下来要做的是 “taking advantage of a break to do some horse riding... good for my CV, to show I’d be good in action films”（练习骑马技能），对应 A 选项 “练习有用的技能”。B 选项 “主演电视节目”、C 选项 “参演激动人心的电影”、D 选项 “教授高级表演课程” 与原文 “试镜失败后休息，练习骑马” 不符。

questions.text: What would Toby write in his blog about acting?

options.label: A
options.text: I’m still trying to find a good way to deal with being told I’m not the right person for a role – it just doesn’t get any easier, I’m afraid!

options.label: B
options.text: I’m so pleased I’ve been in such a variety of films. My favourites are the funny ones – they’re always fun, as you’d expect!

options.label: C
options.text: All my success has come because of someone who was in the audience at a show I did. I’m very lucky!

options.label: D
options.text: I regret wasting time deciding whether to get involved in my first drama group. If you think you’ll enjoy something, try it!

questions.explanation: 解析：C 选项 “我所有的成功都来自于看过我表演的观众。我很幸运！” 与原文 “film director saw me in one of the club’s plays and asked me to be in her film” 一致。A 选项 “仍在找处理落选的方法”、B 选项 “最喜欢喜剧电影”、D 选项 “后悔浪费时间决定加入戏剧俱乐部” 与原文 “喜剧电影不擅长，庆幸加入俱乐部” 不符。
